description: Move apt-get cache cleanup into the SAME RUN instruction as apt-get install, since cleaning it up in a later layer does not shrink the image at all
prompts: The Dockerfile installs curl with apt-get in one RUN instruction, then cleans up the apt cache (`rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`) in a SEPARATE, later RUN instruction. This does NOT shrink the final image at all - Docker layers are additive, so the cache files are already permanently baked into the earlier layer's history; deleting them in a later layer only hides them from that later layer's view, the earlier layer (and the space it uses) is still there. Fix it: merge the cleanup into the SAME RUN instruction as the apt-get install (chained with `&&`), so the cache never gets committed to a layer in the first place. The end result of a successful build (curl installed and usable) must be unchanged.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM debian:12-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
RUN rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
CMD ["curl", "--version"]

test_setup_files.check_apt_cleanup.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

raw = Path("Dockerfile").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]

install_lines = [l for l in lines if l.upper().startswith("RUN") and "apt-get install" in l]
assert install_lines, "no apt-get install RUN instruction found"

merged = [l for l in install_lines if "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists" in l]
assert merged, (
    "apt-get install and the cache cleanup (rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*) must be in the SAME "
    "RUN instruction - cleaning it up in a separate later RUN does not reduce image size, "
    "the cache is already permanently in the earlier layer's history")

cleanup_only_lines = [
    l for l in lines
    if l.upper().startswith("RUN") and "rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists" in l and "apt-get install" not in l
]
assert not cleanup_only_lines, (
    f"found a separate cleanup-only RUN instruction, which achieves nothing: {cleanup_only_lines}")

assert any(l.upper().startswith("CMD") and "curl" in l for l in lines), "CMD changed unexpectedly"

print("PASS apt cache cleanup checks")

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM debian:12-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
CMD ["curl", "--version"]
